name: Code review
summary: Have Claude look for bugs in your changes, on your machine, in the cloud or on GitHub pull requests.
what: /code-review checks a branch, pull request, path or commit range for correctness bugs in your own session and can apply the fixes. Ultrareview runs a deeper review in the cloud with several agents that verify each finding. Team and Enterprise organizations can also have Claude review GitHub pull requests automatically.

impact.title: Catch bugs before merge
impact.detail: Findings point at real problems in the diff.

impact.title: Fewer false alarms
impact.detail: Ultrareview and GitHub reviews verify findings before reporting them.

impact.title: Fix in one step
impact.detail: --fix applies the findings to your files.

howItWorks: Run /code-review, optionally with a target such as a branch range or PR number.
Add --fix to apply findings, or --comment to post them on the pull request.
Run /code-review ultra for the cloud review; Pro, Max and Ultra get 3 free runs, then usage credits.
On Team and Enterprise, an owner can turn on automatic GitHub reviews; comment @claude review to ask for one.
Tune what gets flagged with CLAUDE.md, or REVIEW.md for GitHub reviews.

events.note: Added /ultrareview, a multi-agent code review that runs in the cloud.
/simplify was renamed /code-review and now reports correctness bugs.
